name: Evil In The World
overview: Scripture reveals that evil is deeply rooted in the human heart, as seen in Genesis 6:5 where mankind's thoughts are continually evil. Isaiah 5:20 warns against distorting moral truth by calling evil good and good evil, highlighting the spiritual blindness that accompanies sin. Jesus foretells persecution for His followers in Matthew 24:9, demonstrating that evil opposes the gospel. Yet, God's love is supreme, offering salvation through Christ (John 3:16) and calling sinners out of darkness, since those who do evil avoid the light to hide their deeds (John 3:20). This underscores the conflict between God's holy ways and human rebellion (Isaiah 55:8).
